title: Hyp Genus3 Height Perf
objective: Reduce the prepared genus-3 canonical-height theta path by at least fivefold while preserving exact finite replay and Magma agreement.

handoff.summary: Prepared and cached the exact-period A-coordinate map and individual normalized Abel lifts, with exact duplicate/conjugate linear reuse and conservative refinement bounds. Replaced independent cubic theta enumerations by a cached tau-only lattice plan, a reanchored last-coordinate recurrence, and one deterministic traversal for the radius-r and radius-(r+2) sums. Cache identity uses every active-precision mpf bit, while large phase arguments select a collision-free direct single-traversal fallback. The pinned Magma radius-6 public height replay fell from 407.87s to 65.68s (6.21x), retained exact finite replay and refinement stability, and agrees with Magma within 1.85e-20. The structural regression independently recomputes the legacy direct lattice sums and checks that a warm radius-4 evaluation uses 170 exponentials instead of 2926 term exponentials.
risks: Theta truncation and rounding remain explicitly nonrigorous; the optimization preserves the existing radius-refinement witness rather than claiming an enclosure.
The exact-process caches are deliberately bounded (12 theta plans, 12 coordinate maps, and 64 point lifts), so workloads cycling through many unrelated period matrices will see cold-plan costs.
Matrices or Abel arguments whose real phase scale exceeds 2^24 intentionally use the slower direct fine-cube traversal so argument reduction cannot corrupt the recurrence path.
pnpm test:changed reached the unit tier but failed only because the new claimed test is not yet registered in the shared central test manifest, which this lane must not edit.
